name: Auryn
source:
Owner and barkeep of the Raven’s Roost. No one knows how she accumulated it, but she has nearly limitless wealth.

A fearsome & proud woman who always gets what she wants—always.

Due to Auryn’s very unique dress code for her barmaids, the tavern draws in spectators as much as drinkers.

On Ciara’s request, she offers Fiona a job...
